text: There are several litigation proceedings involving government claims to recover costs incurred as a result of the opioid crisis. The claims are being advanced against the manufacturers and distributors of prescription opioids in the United States and Canada. Confidential Attachment 1 contains legal advice from the City Solicitor regarding these legal proceedings.

City Council on February 2 and 3, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2022) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2022) from the City Solicitor, at the discretion of the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2022) from the City Solicitor remain confidential as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client and litigation privilege.
